subject: Game Theory
title: How Much Should You Bid?
description: A micro-lesson that makes How Much Should You Bid? usable.

hook.text: Your optimal bid depends on the auction type, the competition, and your own private valuation.

buildup.text: In an English auction, bid up to your value and stop. The format protects you from overpaying.

discovery.text: In sealed-bid auctions, shade your bid below your value. Winning at your max value means zero profit.

twist.text: More competitors mean less shading. With many rivals, bidding close to your true value gets safer.

climax.text: Professional bidders estimate competitors' values, then calculate the optimal shade.

punchline.text: Bid to win, not to overpay.
